title: showMore() is not a function
body:
I'm trying to implement a custom infiniteHits with a showMore button:

on https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/infinite-hits/js/#connector

at the showMore section, there is an example with a custom item rendering, I have copy/past that example without changing anything. It works fine, by that I mean it shows my items, but as soon as I click on showMore button it return : showMore is not a function.
